programme.title: La petite maison dans la prairie
programme.desc: Laura and her husband Almanzo look after their daughter and niece after the death of Almanzo's brother. Meanwhile, a new family moves into the Ingalls house.
First responders and emergency service personnel rally to save lives on and off the job. However, they also struggle with balancing their high octane jobs and their personal lives.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF HEROES
programme.desc: Yinggu tiba di sebuah kuil, di mana Putera Duan tinggal untuk membalas dendam terhadapnya. Putera Duan kini dikenali Master Yi Deng setelah menjadi rahib. Yinggu menyimpan dendam terhadap Yi Deng kerana menyebabkan kematian anaknya.

programme.title: LET'S GO HOME
programme.desc: Let's Go Home menampilkan artis 8TV akan pulang ke kampung halaman mereka, menunjukkan tanda penghargaan kepada individu yang membesarkan mereka dan juga tempat mereka dibesarkan.

programme.title: WOMEN WALK THE LINE
programme.desc: Gu Qiao dituduh mengabaikan tugasnya menyebabkan pelanggannya mengalami kerugian besar. Pelanggan tersebut mengugut untuk mendedahkan penglibatan Shu Mei Corporation dalam skandal tersebut jika Gu Qiao tidak dipecat.

programme.title: YOUR FINESSE
programme.desc: Rupa-rupanya niat Mie Shbian datang ke Jiang Gong adalah untuk membalas dendam. Fei Ren yang berada di atas pentas menterjemah ucapan Shabian secara sembarangan, menyebabkan khalayak ramai bersorak kerana tersalah faham.

programme.title: MY TWIN LOVER
programme.desc: Ming and Qin, twin brothers, Gemini, 35 years old. The identical twins are so alike even their own family can’t tell them apart. When they were young, they also pretend to be each other, the older one will swap places with the younger one.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Daisy yang mengandung berjaya melahirkan seorang anak perempuan tetapi mengalami pendarahan teruk. Semasa dalam perjalanan ke sebuah hospital lain, kereta yang dipandu oleh Zi Sheng terlibat dalam pelanggaran dengan sebuah kereta lain.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Meng Zi menonjolkan bakatnya dalam jamuan walaupun dihina oleh Cai Xia dan Xin Xian. Namun, Meng Zi kekal bertekad memikat Xin Xian. Dia kemudian meminta bantuan Du Yin, yang berjanji akan membantunya menawan hati Xin Xian.

programme.title: THE QUEEN OF NEWS 2
programme.desc: Majlis Anugerah Kewartawanan Profesional yang memaksa Ka-yin menukar sikap demi meraih penaja. Situasi menjadi gamat apabila Man dipanggil secara mengejut bagi mengawal keadaan seorang tetamu yang jatuh sakit.

programme.title: PURSUIT OF JADE
programme.desc: Yan Zheng bertengkar dengan Chang Yu sebelum berangkat. Chang Yu mendapati Yan Zheng sudah pergi apabila bangun daripada tidur. Yan Zheng meninggalkan sepasang pelindung pergelangan tangan kulit di buat sendirinya untuk Chang Yu.

programme.title: I BELIEVE I CAN FLY
programme.desc: Shun Tian dimaklumkan bahawa dia hanya tinggal kurang daripada setahun untuk terus hidup. Disebabkan ayahnya adalah satu-satunya ahli keluarga terdekat, tetapi menghidap demensia, atas nasihat peguam, Shun Tian menubuhkan sebuah dana.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF HEROES
programme.desc: Huang Rong dan Guo Jing bertemu semula dengan Zhou Botong, tetapi keberadaan Hong Qigong tidak diketahui. Tidak lama kemudian, mereka terserempak dengan Ke Zhen Er, ketua kumpulan maha guru Jiangnan.

programme.title: HO CHAK! 2025/2026
programme.desc: Episod ini hos Orange dan pembaca berita Summer mengunjungi tiga restoran popular di KL: Stesen Nasi Kerabu, Roots Bangar, dan By Age 18-KL. Mereka mengesyorkan pelbagai hidangan enak seperti Nasi Lemak Risotto dan Nasi Kerabu Ayam Bakar.

programme.title: WOMEN WALK THE LINE
programme.desc: Gu Qiao enggan menerima penjelasan Yuan Ge atas pemecatannya. Sementara itu, Yuan Ge berusaha menyelesaikan pertikaian tentang pelanggaran hak paten melibatkan Shu Mei Corporation dan mendapati siapa dalang yang sebenar.

programme.title: YOUR FINESSE
programme.desc: Gao Qiang dan Fu Ling yang rasa kecewa kerana hal percintaan, bertindak sesuka hati untuk melepaskan emosi mereka. Namun, mereka terperangkap apabila seorang nenek merompak restoran yang mereka kunjungi.

programme.title: THE MEMOIR OF MAJIE
programme.desc: Yu Hong telah dipaksa berkahwin dengan seorang tua dan pada hari perkahwinan itu, orang tua itu meninggal dunia.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Meng Zi menonjolkan bakatnya dalam jamuan walaupun dihina oleh Cai Xia dan Xin Xian. Namun, Meng Zi kekal bertekad memikat Xin Xian. Dia kemudian meminta bantuan Du Yin, yang berjanji akan membantunya menawan hati Xin Xian.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Chang Sheng terserempak dengan Xin Xian di tempat letak kereta. Mereka perselisihan faham dan bertengkar. Chang Sheng, Wan Chao Yuan dan Xin Xian setelah hadir di sebuah perjumpaan untuk membeli Hotel Riyuexing.

programme.title: THE QUEEN OF NEWS 2
programme.desc: Man mendedahkan kepada Kit dan Ying-fei mengenai rahsia Suetkwun sedang menjalankan siasatan ke atas sebuah skandal di Amerika dan pembantunya, Ivy dibunuh. Suetkwun lari ke Hong Kong untuk elak menerima nasib yang sama dengan Ivy.

programme.title: TAIWAN DEKAT JE
programme.desc: Jing Yi dan Kenji melawat beberapa mercu tanda seni bina di Taiwan untuk memahami aspek kemanusiaan, sejarah, seni bina dan budaya tempatan. Mereka mengunjungi Muzium Ju Ming yang ditubuhkan pada tahun 1999.

programme.title: FAMILY SINGING SHOW SS6
programme.desc: Episod ini 6 kumpulan di bawah pimpinan pengadil Christopher Lai Sheng Ming bertanding untuk dipilih bagi memasuki pertandingan yang seterusnya. Mereka mempersembahkan bakat nyanyian mereka dan diadili oleh 5 orang pengadil.

programme.title: TILL THE END OF THE MOON
programme.desc: Tai Jin enggan menerima hakikat kematian Xi Wu. Sementara itu, Bing Chang ditangkap ketika cuba menyelinap keluar dari ibu kota negara Jing. Dia mengaku membunuh neneknya. Tai Jin menitahkan hukuman ke atas Bing Chang.

programme.title: Quanzhou Puppet Theater: China's "Pinocchio Adventure"
programme.desc: In the film, the puppet Pinocchio, carved and created by an old carpenter, comes to life as a real human. Puppets are lifeless by nature - it is the masterful skills of their puppeteers' fingertips that breathe life into them. What does China's own "Pinocchio Adventure" look like? This episode takes you into the world of Quanzhou String Puppet Theater. Explore behind-the-scenes stories, from the intricate carving of puppet heads to the art of puppet performance, and witness how the dance of ten fingers and threads weaves a thousand vivid characters to life!

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music." The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.desc: This is Xu Shichang, a 'jinshi' which means a successful candidate in the highest imperial examinations. His diaries offer a glimpse into the intrigues, alliances and power struggles that shaped a turbulent era.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music." The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its "mother tree" to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet!

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it's all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village - a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai - the world's largest Miao village - and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing's Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance - featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon - and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as "Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate," "Mudfish Eating Dumplings," and "Three Dragons." Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance expresses values of unity, vitality, and harmony with nature. While a few iconic forms like the Fire Dragon remain widely recognized, many others are on the verge of extinction and in urgent need of preservation. In this episode, the host travels to Chongqing to meet with four inheritors of the Tongliang Dragon Dance. Through their stories, we uncover the rich legacy of this dazzling tradition, explore the deep roots of dragon culture in the region, and trace the origins of one of China's most awe-inspiring folk arts.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village - a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai - the world's largest Miao village - and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: The Tongliang Dragon Dance
programme.desc: The Tongliang Dragon Dance is a traditional performance art rooted in Chongqing's Tongliang District, characterized by its elaborate dragon props and dynamic choreography. Originating in the Ming Dynasty and flourishing during the Qing, this vibrant folk tradition has regained its brilliance in modern times and earned international acclaim. The dance consists of two main branches: the dragon lantern dance - featuring forms like the Grand Wriggling Dragon, the Fire Dragon, and the Straw Dragon - and the festive lantern dance, which includes acts such as "Carp Leaps Over the Dragon Gate," "Mudfish Eating Dumplings," and "Three Dragons." Steeped in cultural symbolism, the Tongliang Dragon Dance expresses values of unity, vitality, and harmony with nature. While a few iconic forms like the Fire Dragon remain widely recognized, many others are on the verge of extinction and in urgent need of preservation. In this episode, the host travels to Chongqing to meet with four inheritors of the Tongliang Dragon Dance. Through their stories, we uncover the rich legacy of this dazzling tradition, explore the deep roots of dragon culture in the region, and trace the origins of one of China's most awe-inspiring folk arts.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village - a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations, visits Xijiang Qianhu Miaozhai - the world's largest Miao village - and learns to forge a small yet meaningful piece of Miao silver ornament.

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly engaging and visually appealing viewing experience.

Renowned international Islamic scholar Mufti Menk returns to Kuala Lumpur for Mufti Menk Live in Malaysia 2026.

programme.desc: Instruction Manual for WE ARE THE NIGHT x I’m LIVE by WE ARE THE NIGHT [Club Midnight] Please enjoy our journey into the unknown [ A Field Day] Don’t you sometimes feel like you’ve lost something? programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
MGFF x I’m LIVE
<LID> A grand opening of today’s performance, this song's daring message is “love is dead” <Shoes> Let’s speed up the tempo and feel the green summer <Wannabe> Why don’t we take a break and listen to the surroundings that make our hearts race? <Supergreen> This is our interpretation of “green” with subtle guitar riffs and energetic rhythms <Monopoly> This is an ode to youth that we sing to bless you

programme.title: I'M LIVE - FROM ALL TO HUMAN
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the R&B quintet FROM ALL TO HUMAN! Composed of vocalist Blesssing guitarist PARK JAE WOO bassist NAM WOO SEOK keyboardist MOON SUNG HWAN and drummer MOON SEONG HO this band brought a new wave of R&B to the Korean music scene upon their debut in 2017. With their band's name referring to a journey “from all beings to humans” the five hope to develop every day as musicians. True to their name they are evolving and developing every day winning the Grand Prize at the 2019 Shinhan Card Rookie Project and the TOP2 at KT&G’s SangSang Madang Band Discovery Competition in 2019. From acid jazz to R&B to new jack swing the quintet covers a wide range of genres in their music backed up by solid storylines which makes them truly one of a kind. In this episode FROM ALL TO HUMAN performs Dizzy Oriental chill Don't be disappointed and more to showcase the quintessence of their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these five genuine musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - ADOY
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the city pop band ADOY! Composed of vocalist and guitarist Oh Juhwan keyboardist Zee bassist Jung Dayoung and drummer Park Geunchang this quartet burst onto the music scene in 2017 with the EP CATNIP. Thanks to the success of Grace and San Francisco from the EP they topped the K-Indie Chart and became nominated for Best Modern Rock at the prestigious Korean Music Awards in 2018. Then in the following year they won Judges' Prize at the Seoul Music Awards creating a new flow of Korean city pop. ADOY's music has a special power. Iit fills the city with romantic vibes instantly and also transforms city noises into sophisticated tunes. What's more their music has mass appeal yet it is unique. So now the quartet itself is a genre that mesmerizes not only Korean listeners but also the world. Last month ADOY released their new EP her to display their ever-evolving artistry and the quartet is here to perform their latest tracks including Simply Antihero Baby and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet ADOY!

programme.desc: Konsert karnival paling ikonik di Malaysia kini kembali! programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: New popular pets of the dark world have all "crawled" out and gathered together?! Dark cuisines made from insects can also taste delicious?! Eye-opening! Cold and arrogant reptiles can be obedient?! Experts demonstrate how to take care of reptiles at home in person?! Surprise! All cute dark pets are present at a gathering of reptile friends?!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt has to find out why Izzy, a cockatoo, has plucked herself almost bare and he performs an urgent operation to save the life of Jerry, the pregnant corn snake. He puts two fat cats on a regime to lose weight while at Flamingoland, he faces the challenge of knocking out a big cat for a spot of surgery.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. There are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. White rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.desc: No wonder dogs are man's - and women's - best friend, when they give us so much to laugh about! Daft dogs, singing dogs, disobedient dogs, dogs dressed up to the canines - they're all here, obligingly caught on camera doing something hilarious.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: Talented tabbies, mischievous moggies and fabulous feline fails - they're all here, plus we're catching up with the stars of some of the web's most popular cat videos.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The era of high housing prices shocks the masses. However, some are willing to live in the mountains for their beloved parrots, just to give them the best breeding environment. programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Baxter is a Shih-Tzu that was discovered abandoned in an empty house on the outskirts of Manchester; thin and with extremely matted fur. Inspector Lyndsey Taylor comes to the rescue, but until all that fur is removed, nobody knows what lies beneath.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Dogs are not only man's best friend, they can also serve as therapists. “Cute Pet Guide” help you train your dog to become a therapy dog. Aside from canned dog food, owners can be more attentive and prepare sumptuous meals for their pets through chef video tutorials. “Cute Pet Guide” will present you and your furry babies with exquisite dishes of love!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt rushes off to answer an urgent call from Flamingoland, where a pregnant rare pygmy goat may need an emergency caesarean. Eight abandoned baby rabbits need some very close attention while back at the zoo there's been trouble at the lemur house. A fight has left one female with a nasty wound but she'd reluctant to receive treatment.

programme.title: Scruffts
programme.desc:
Six dogs, six handlers, all competing in the world’s largest and most famous dog show: "Crufts".
But they are not the pedigree pooches who compete to be labelled "Best in Show". These are the loveable family pets competing to win the "Scruffts" title.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: National Anthem
programme.desc: The broadcast of Malaysia’s national anthem, Negaraku, marks the beginning of the daytime broadcast schedule.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us is a compilation of human-interest stories from around the world. This episode features a Women-run hotel in Sri Lanka that empowers women through the tourism industry. It also highlights Traditional wooden toy-making in Channapatna, India, where local artisans strive to preserve their craft amid modernisation and competition from imported products. Efforts to save the northern white rhino at Ol Pejeta Conservancy in Kenya continue through in vitro fertilisation (IVF) technology to prevent the subspecies from becoming extinct. Meanwhile, Benin’s textile industry is expanding its local manufacturing capabilities, shifting from raw cotton exports to textile production to create jobs and boost the country’s economy. The episode also explores the importance of international engagement and dialogue in helping countries such as Malaysia compete in an increasingly interconnected world.

programme.title: Global Perspective
programme.desc: This episode of Global Perspective discusses the evolution of Malaysia’s foreign policy since Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim took office in November 2022, focusing on strengthening ties with Islamic countries in areas including the Palestinian issue, economic cooperation, education and moderation. The programme also highlights Malaysia’s strategic relations with Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan and Central Asia, as well as the potential for international media collaboration to strengthen diplomacy and deliver accurate information to global audiences.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us explores diverse cultural traditions, artistic expressions and heritage from around the world, including ice carving in Japan, a unique peanut butter art installation in Rotterdam, Arabian horse traditions in Palestine and camel racing in Australia. This episode also highlights the traditional fishing practices of the Imragan community in Mauritania, France’s return of historical Syrian artefacts, and Malaysia’s strategic role in strengthening international relations and amplifying the voices of the Global South.

programme.title: ASEAN - Rasa ASEAN
programme.desc: Rasa ASEAN is an 11-episode travelogue featuring fusion cuisine from ASEAN countries while showcasing local cultures and traditions. Hosted by Chef Fikri and Chef Naim, the programme brings together professional and renowned chefs to explore the region’s diverse culinary heritage.\n\nIn this episode, both chefs travel to Cambodia to discover its local cuisine and cultural traditions.

programme.title: ASEAN - Jejak Halal ASEAN
programme.desc: Jejak Halal ASEAN is a travelogue exploring the diverse cultures and lifestyles of Muslim communities across ASEAN countries. In this episode, the programme travels to Songkhla, Thailand, to discover the local Muslim community and its way of life.

programme.title: ASEAN -Women Entrepreneurship
programme.desc: This episode of ASEAN Women Entrepreneurship highlights the determination of women entrepreneurs from Cambodia and Brunei in developing their businesses and contributing to economic growth. It also explores the challenges they face, the importance of support systems, and business strategies in empowering women to succeed in entrepreneurship.

programme.title: National Anthem
programme.desc: The broadcast of Malaysia’s national anthem, Negaraku, marks the beginning of the daytime broadcast schedule.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us is a compilation of human-interest stories from around the world. This episode features a Women-run hotel in Sri Lanka that empowers women through the tourism industry. It also highlights Traditional wooden toy-making in Channapatna, India, where local artisans strive to preserve their craft amid modernisation and competition from imported products. Efforts to save the northern white rhino at Ol Pejeta Conservancy in Kenya continue through in vitro fertilisation (IVF) technology to prevent the subspecies from becoming extinct. Meanwhile, Benin’s textile industry is expanding its local manufacturing capabilities, shifting from raw cotton exports to textile production to create jobs and boost the country’s economy. The episode also explores the importance of international engagement and dialogue in helping countries such as Malaysia compete in an increasingly interconnected world.

programme.title: Global Perspective
programme.desc: This episode of Global Perspective discusses the evolution of Malaysia’s foreign policy since Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim took office in November 2022, focusing on strengthening ties with Islamic countries in areas including the Palestinian issue, economic cooperation, education and moderation. The programme also highlights Malaysia’s strategic relations with Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan and Central Asia, as well as the potential for international media collaboration to strengthen diplomacy and deliver accurate information to global audiences.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: World Around Us explores diverse cultural traditions, artistic expressions and heritage from around the world, including ice carving in Japan, a unique peanut butter art installation in Rotterdam, Arabian horse traditions in Palestine and camel racing in Australia. This episode also highlights the traditional fishing practices of the Imragan community in Mauritania, France’s return of historical Syrian artefacts, and Malaysia’s strategic role in strengthening international relations and amplifying the voices of the Global South.

programme.title: Morning Music 音乐早点
programme.desc: 《音乐早点》你最贴心的早间声音伴侣。我们不聊冗长的资讯，只精选最舒缓、最动听的旋律，配合清新的晨间絮语，为你卸去昨夜的疲惫，装满清晨的能量。无论你正行走在通勤的路上，还是在享用一份惬意的早餐，让《音乐早点》用惬意的乐音，陪你开启美好而有温度的一天。

programme.desc: 星期一道星期六，下午4-5点，忙碌的午后，需要适时的暂停。《音乐下午茶》 是一档专为午后时光打造的治愈系音乐随笔节目。

programme.title: 下班开麦啦
programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.title: 听歌好时光
programme.desc: 忙碌的生活里，你有多久没有好好听完一首歌了？这里是《听歌好时光》，你的私享音乐会客厅。我们不设复杂的门槛，没有沉重的叙事，只挑选最惬意、最动听的旋律，为你揉碎日常的喧嚣。沏一杯清茶，或是斟一杯咖啡，在这个专属的空间里，让我们用好歌慢下来，静静享受属于你的好时光。

programme.title: Local Talent 珈有访客
programme.desc: 谁说好音乐都在远方？在我们脚下的这片土地，正涌动着最炙热的创作力量！《珈有访客》由主持人“珈”领衔，每期锁定宝藏本地艺人，为你抢先解锁他们的最新单曲、创作灵感与幕后八卦。从独立摇滚到温柔民谣，从流行打榜到本土原创，带你深度破圈，一起成为本地音乐的最强后援团！

programme.title: Behave
programme.desc: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Chop Chop
programme.desc: A young couple's tranquility is shattered by a psychotic serial killer one quiet evening. Their battle for survival reveals hidden truths, entangling them unwittingly with the criminal underworld.

programme.title: 3AM
programme.desc: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

programme.desc: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.
